changes.title: Track collected upgrades and strength by region
changes.text: Upgrade Scrolls and Strength Potions now show first successful inventory collection counts by original region. Strength Potions also show whether each guaranteed early or late floor pair was collected. Bonus potions cannot hide a missed guaranteed potion. Older saves keep partial counts and explicitly unknown earlier pairs. Merges, splits, transfers, saves and drop-and-pickup repeats preserve or consume each origin exactly once without changing generation.

changes.title: Hand UIMSD the exact validated READY model
changes.text: The title preload is now claimed on a short prioritized worker and the exact validated mutable model is handed to the render thread before switching scenes. Stale open callbacks cannot replace a later scene, and cache misses return to normal priority before cold loading. Full raw-history freshness validation and the unchanged 250 ms two-opening acceptance limit remain intact.

changes.title: Preserve original generation, language and failed-candidate evidence
changes.text: Keep all original level-generation golden hashes with recorder off and on while excluding only new statistics bookkeeping from the historical test snapshot; real saves retain it. Audit all 5076 English strings. Preserve TEST332's exact artifacts, six-profile display success and sole exact-model-identity failure without claiming acceptance or delivery. Require complete core, Android, history, identity, tooltip and display evidence for TEST333.

commentary: TEST333 compares the immediate compiled TEST332, not TEST330.
